message.ultracraft.content:
Welcome to Ultracraft V2.1!
This Mod aims to recreate the game Ultrakill (by §6Arsi "Hakita" Patala§f) and its mechanics in Minecraft. This Update includes:
- Level + Scripting System
- 4 new Weapon Variants (Overheat Nailgun + Slab Revolvers)
- Limbo Dimension
- Structures
- Tons of new Blocks
- A LOT more than I could fit here

Please be sure to report Issues//Bugs and send any Feedback you have my way!
Relevant Links are in the Mod Info.
Oh and join the Discord Community for (relatively) regular teasers!

☆ Absolutelyaya ☆
